Header: Striga hermonthica Del. Akenchira, metselem, deiso

Prevention: Use high seed rate and fertiliser to supress the weed: 100kg
Ha or reduce urea to 50kg/Ha in moisture stressed areas.
DAP should be applied at time of planting and urea 35-40 days after
Desmodium (Push-pull) to inhibit the haustorial development
Use trap crops like cotton (Roba variety), groundnut, cowpea, sunflower (Russian black variety) and soyabean
Intercrop with haricot beans (one row of haricot beans and two row of sorghum)
Rotate (3-6 years) with cowpea, beans or groundnuts
Monitoring: Look for chlorotic/ yellowish blotches 1cm long by 0.5 cm wide on the foliage.
Uprooting may confirm the presence of haustoria and young parasite seedlings on the roots.
Look for curling of leaves and drought- stressed like appearance
At later stages look for weeds with purple flowers
Take direct action after one striga plant is seen
Direct Control: Striga weeds and burn at the beginning of flowering within 3 weeks and before seed setting to reduce dispersal of more seed
Hoe or handweed regularly starting two weeks after germination then weed again six to eight weeks after
Apply organic well composted fertilisers and irrigate during dry periods so that plants don’t get stressed
Avoid grazing animals in the crop because they will spread the seeds
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides of
Directorate, Ethiopia 2,4-D on emerged weed to reduce the seed bank for the coming seasons.
WHO II moderately hazardous, Post-emergence herbicide against broadleaved weeds, apply when sorghum is 6-15 inches tall.
Do not use if sorghum is intercroped with other crops.
Apply early in the morning or late in the evening, buit not if it is rainy or windy.
